q: For the doubling map T(x)=2x mod 1, the orbit of a rational x=p/q is:
opts: Eventually periodic with period equal to the multiplicative order of 2 mod q
exp: Rationals under the doubling map: 2ⁿ·(p/q) mod 1 is eventually periodic because {2ⁿ mod q} is periodic. The period equals the multiplicative order of 2 modulo q. Rational orbits are never random (periodic = compressible).
